data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to setup and control VPN connections via Wireguard tunnels.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to initialize, start, and stop WireGuard VPN tunnels across multiple platforms. It provides streams and methods to check the current connection stage.
use_when: You need to connect your Flutter application to a WireGuard VPN server.
You want to monitor VPN connection state changes in real-time.
avoid_when: You are building a general-purpose HTTP/WebSocket networking app that does not require a VPN tunnel.
strengths: Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Provides real-time updates on VPN connection stages.
weaknesses: Requires administrator privileges on Windows and sudo/root privileges on Linux to create and manipulate tunnels.
Platform-specific system dependencies must be configured (e.g., wireguard-tools on Linux).
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration such as administrative permissions on Windows, installing wireguard and wireguard-tools on Linux, and configuring provider bundle identifiers on iOS.
